claims.explanation: Zolantidine is annotated as a histamine H2 receptor antagonist, but the abstracts show it is inactive in the CNS assays where H1 antagonists work, and the virtual-cell response resembles dopamine/serotonin receptor antagonists rather than histamine-pathway drugs. The selective killing pattern is best explained by sensitivity of lines with activated RAS/MAPK or PI3K/PTEN pathway alterations, since these pathways are enriched among the most-killed lines and depleted among the least-affected lines. The drug may therefore act through an off-target kinase or GPCR pathway rather than through H2 receptors.

features.basis: PTEN-mutant lines are enriched among the most selectively killed lines (JHUEM2, KALS1, UACC62, SF126, ESS1, 8MGBA, GP2D, SNU410)
PIK3CA-mutant lines are enriched among the most selectively killed lines (HGC27, JHUEM2, 253J, ESS1, GP2D, MKN1)
KRAS-mutant lines are enriched among the most selectively killed lines (KPNSI9S, NCIH1792, GP2D, SNU410)
BRAF-mutant lines are enriched among the most selectively killed lines (LOXIMVI, UACC62, NMCG1)
NF1-mutant lines are enriched among the most selectively killed lines (KALS1, LOXIMVI, ESS1, GP2D)
CTNNB1-mutant lines are enriched among the most selectively killed lines (JHUEM2, U2OS, LXF289)
TP53 mutation is nearly universal in both killed and least-affected lines, so it does not explain selectivity
CDKN2A mutation is common in the least-affected lines (CAL12T, SCABER, YD10B, 8305C, NCIH1703)
SMARCA4 mutation appears in least-affected lines (NCIH1793, NCIH1703) and in killed COV434, so evidence is weak
ARID1A mutation appears in several killed lines (JHUEM2, LOXIMVI, GP2D) but also in least-affected NCIH1793 and KU1919
SETD2 mutation appears in least-affected lines (VMRCRCW, NCIH1623) and in killed LOXIMVI and 253J, so evidence is weak
SF3B1 mutation appears in several least-affected lines (LS1034, UO31, NCIH1703, CAL12T) and in killed ESS1 and HEPG2
